content.name: Padraig Lonergan
profile: Environmental scientist with seven years in water quality monitoring and catchment management, mostly in the south-east. Good comunication skills with farmers, county council staff and the public, and comfortable presenting technical results to non-technical audiences.

details: Thesis: nitrate trends in the River Barrow catchment

experience.title: Catchment Scientist
bullets: Designed and ran the trust's monitoring programme across forty sampling points, from field work to the annual report.
Worked with over sixty farm holdings on nutrient management plans under an agri-environment scheme.
Secured grant funding for a riparian fencing project and managed the contractors who delivered it.
Presented results to the county council water forum twice a year.

experience.title: Environmental Technician
bullets: Carried out water and soil sampling for environmental impact assessments on wind farm and road schemes.
Maintained the sample chain-of-custody records and liased with the accredited laboratory.

additional: Volunteering: Tidy Towns river clean-up coordinator, Enniscorthy
Volunteering: volunteer angling instructor with a local youth club
Publications: co-author of a technical note on nitrate trends in the Barrow, Irish Freshwater Bulletin
Full clean driving licence and own vehicle
